documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Post Buyback Public Announcement
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: VRL Logistics reported a strong financial and operational performance for Q2 FY27, driven by higher freight realizations, increased goods transport volumes, and robust cost management. Total income grew by approximately 20% year-on-year to INR 967 crores, while EBITDA surged 43% to INR 226 crores with margins expanding to 23.3%. The company added 51 new branches during the quarter and reduced its net debt to INR 337 crores alongside executing a share buyback program. Management guided for sustainable EBITDA margins of 21% to 22% and double-digit volume growth going forward. VRL Logistics reported its financial and operational results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, highlighting a 20% year-on-year increase in Q2 total income to ₹966.6 crore and an EBITDA growth of 43% to ₹225.6 crore.

guidance.claim: Management expects volume growth of 9% to 10% to continue in the second half of the year.
guidance.quote: This first half, we already did around 9.5% growth in the tonnage. The similar growth we are expecting even in the second half of the year.

guidance.claim: The company targets sustainable EBITDA margins of 21% to 22% going forward.
guidance.quote: Yes, around 21%-22% is a sustainable EBITDA margin even going forward.

guidance.claim: Management guides for revenue growth of at least 10% to 12% for the next year.
guidance.quote: Overall, assume that if there is no change in the realization from now onward, for the next year at least, the guidance will be the revenue will increase at least around 10%-12%.

guidance.claim: Management estimates full-year capital expenditure in the range of around Rs. 220 crores to Rs. 240 crores.
guidance.quote: And out of this Rs. 500 crores, the CAPEX will be around Rs. 220 crores – Rs. 240 crores, roughly, in a full year basis.

demand_outlook.claim: FMCG and textiles are experiencing good growth compared to industrial and other segments due to the festival season.
demand_outlook.quote: Considering these festival seasons and all, now FMCG and textile, there is a good growth compared to the industrial and other segments.

demand_outlook.claim: Tonnage growth in October reached over 20% compared to the previous year.
demand_outlook.quote: Our tonnage growth in the month of October is around 20% plus compared to year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that revenue growth was driven by a strong value proposition and deep customer trust, with volumes increasing 11% Q2YoY.
demand_outlook.quote: Driven by strong value proposition and deep customer trust, business improved with volumes increasing 11% Q2YoY , 6% QoQ & 10% H1YoY

demand_outlook.claim: Volumes grew by 9% year-on-year from 9,35,000 metric tons to 10,19,000 metric tons.
demand_outlook.quote: The growth in revenue is also on account of growth in volumes by 90% from Rs. 9,35,000 metric tons to Rs. 10,19,000 metric tons.

demand_outlook.claim: Volume grew by 10% in July and management expects similar growth for the full quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: July, we already performed around 10% growth in the tonnage and we are expecting similar growth, at least around, on a full quarter basis, 9% growth is possible.

demand_outlook.claim: Sequential volumes saw a minor moderation of 1.73% due to seasonal demand moderation.
demand_outlook.quote: And there is some conflict in volumes by 1.73% in the quarter due to seasonal demand moderation.

capex_expansion.claim: The company added 51 branches during the quarter, bringing total new branches added in the first half to 67.
capex_expansion.quote: During this quarter, we added 51 branches, taking the total number of new branches added during the first half to 67 numbers.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure is expected to be around INR 150 crores to INR 160 crores in the second half.
capex_expansion.quote: No, basically, in the second half, again, we are expecting a capital expenditure of around INR150 crores, INR160 crores, which is including the vehicles as well as some of the one or two properties what we are planning.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure will continue at around INR 250 crores to INR 300 crores every year.
capex_expansion.quote: But the capital expenditure will be at least around INR250 crores-INR300 crores every year it will continue, considering our good cash flow.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its footprint by adding 67 new branches in H1FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: We expanded our footprint by adding 67 new branches in H1FY27, strengthening our geographic reach

capex_expansion.claim: Total capital expenditure incurred in H1FY27 was ₹158 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Total CAPEX incurred in H1FY27 is ₹ 158 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Properties were purchased at Vijayawada, Nagpur, Chikkamagaluru, Aroor, Lucknow, and Raipur to support future expansion plans.
capex_expansion.quote: Purchase of properties at Vijayawada, Nagpur, Chikkamagaluru, Aroor, Lucknow, Raipur. The size and key location of these properties make it ideal for future expansion plans to support the Company's growth objectives

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure during the quarter was Rs. 76 crores, utilized for commercial vehicles and land/building facilities.
capex_expansion.quote: The cash flow of have been effectively utilized for the purpose of capital expenditure to the tune of Rs. 76 crores in the current quarter mainly for the purpose of addition of commercial vehicles of Rs. 18 crores and Rs. 49 crores is utilized for the purchase of land and building facilities in the critical locations of our operations.

capex_expansion.claim: Annual capital expenditure will consist of a mix of vehicles and properties, with vehicles around Rs. 120 crores to Rs. 140 crores and the remaining in property.
capex_expansion.quote: It's a mix of vehicles and the property. The vehicle will be around Rs. 120 crores – Rs. 140 crores and the remaining will be adding up some property.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin expanded to 23.3% from 19.7% in the corresponding quarter last year.
margins_costs.quote: Correspondingly, the EBITDA margin expanded to 23.3% from 19.7% in the corresponding quarter last year, an improvement of 367 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: Employee costs declined as a percentage of total income from 18% to 16.48%.
margins_costs.quote: Employee costs declined from 18% to 16.48% of total income, in spite of increase in absolute terms from INR147 crores to INR159 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Administrative expenses declined from 2.28% to 1.43% of total income.
margins_costs.quote: Administrative expenses declined from 2.28% to 1.43%, largely reflecting lower legal and professional expenses incurred in the last year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q2FY27 stood at 23.34%, reflecting a 3.67% increase driven by higher volumes and freight rates.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA 225.6 158.1 23.34% 19.67% 3.67% Increase in Volumes & Freight Rates leads to increase in margins

margins_costs.claim: Direct procurement of fuel decreased as bulk purchase prices were higher than retail prices.
margins_costs.quote: Bulk Purchase from refineries down from 40.6% to 13.1%, as bulk prices were higher than the Retail prices.

margins_costs.claim: Freight rates experienced an uplift due to fuel price escalation alongside the rationalization of freight contracts.
margins_costs.quote: Fuel price escalation along with rationalization of freight contracts necessitated freight rate hike, resulting in 9% Q2YoY, 3% QoQ & 9% H1YoY uplift in realisation.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA increased by around 22% from Rs. 158 crores to Rs. 193 crores, with margin improving from 21.1% to 21.8%.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA is increased around 22% from Rs. 158 crores to Rs. 193 crores and percentage to revenue is increased by 71 basis points from 21.1% to 21.8%.

margins_costs.claim: Fuel procurement cost per liter increased from Rs. 83 to Rs. 94 during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: The fuel procurement cost per liter is increased from Rs. 83 to Rs. 94.

margins_costs.claim: PAT increased to Rs. 81 crores from Rs. 50 crores, with margin expanding from 6.7% to 9%.
margins_costs.quote: The PAT of the company is increased to Rs. 81 crores from Rs. 50 crores and percentage to revenue is increased to 9% from 6.7%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin on a sequential basis improved by 36 basis points from 21.4% to 21.8%.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is improved by 36 basis points from 21.4% to 21.8% mainly driven by increasing in the freight realization.

orders_capacity.claim: Goods transport volumes increased by approximately 11% year-on-year from 976,000 tons to 1,079,000 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: This growth was primarily supported by an approximately 11% increase in goods transport volumes from 976000 tons to 1,079,000 tons, along with a 9% improvement in freight realization per ton from INR8,079 to INR8,840.

orders_capacity.claim: As of the end of H1 FY27, the company's fleet comprised 5,941 vehicles.
orders_capacity.quote: As of the end of H1 FY27, our fleet comprised 5,941 vehicles.

orders_capacity.claim: Approximately 76% of the total fleet is debt-free while around 11% is fully depreciated.
orders_capacity.quote: Approximately 76% of our total fleet is debt-free, while around 11% is fully depreciated and continues to operate in optimal condition.

orders_capacity.claim: The number of branches increased from 1,293 branches in FY26 to 1,337 branches in H1FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Number of branches increased from 1293 branches in FY26 to 1337 branches in H1FY27.

orders_capacity.claim: The number of GT Vehicles increased to 5,941 vehicles in H1FY27, with 238 new vehicles added.
orders_capacity.quote: Number of GT Vehicles increased from 5932 vehicles in FY26 to 5941 vehicles in H1FY27. New Vehicles added in H1FY27 -238 (HCV- 225, LCV-4,SV-8, EV-1), sold/scrapped : 229 vehicles

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates with 6,000 owned vehicles along with hired vehicles, spread across 23 states and 5 union territories with around 1,300 branch networks.
orders_capacity.quote: Today, the company is operating with 6,000 owned vehicles, along with the hired vehicles as well. Today, the operations of the company spreads across 23 states and 5 union territories with around 1,300 branch networks.

orders_capacity.claim: Vehicles travel around 11 lakh kilometers daily to deliver about 12,000 tons of commodities.
orders_capacity.quote: Our vehicles are traveling around 11 lakh kilometers on a daily basis to deliver around 12,000 tons of commodities across the nook and corner of the country.

orders_capacity.claim: Around 79% of the fleet is debt-free and 13% is fully depreciated.
orders_capacity.quote: Around 79% of our fleet is debt free and 13% is fully depreciated providing strong operating leverage.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt decreased to INR 337 crores as of September 30 compared to INR 440 crores as of March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Despite these investments, we have successfully reduced our net debt to INR337 crores as of September 30, compared with INR440 crores as on March 31, 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The board recommended a share buyback program aggregating up to INR 280 crores at a price of INR 320 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: Considering the substantial improvement in profitability, healthy cash generation and the strength of our balance sheet, the board had recommended a share buyback program aggregating up to INR280 crores at a price of INR320 per equity share.

capital_allocation.claim: The share buyback covers up to 87.5 lakh equity shares representing approximately 5% of paid-up equity share capital.
capital_allocation.quote: The proposed buyback covers up to 87.5 lakh equity shares, representing approximately 5% of the company's paid-up equity share capital.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt decreased from ₹440 crores as of March 31, 2026, to ₹337 crores as of September 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Net debt decreased from₹ 440 crores as on 31.03.2026 to ₹ 337 crores as on 30.09.2026

capital_allocation.claim: Surplus cash flows resulted in a reduction in net debt from Rs. 440 crores as of March 31 to Rs. 391 crores at the end of the quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: The remaining surplus cash flow resulted into reduction in net debt from Rs. 440 crores as of 31st March to Rs. 391 crores as of quarter end.

capital_allocation.claim: The board approved a share buyback to the tune of Rs. 280 crores at a price of Rs. 320 per share, subject to shareholder approval.
capital_allocation.quote: Considering the substantial improvement in the profits and the pre-cash flows of the company, the board had approved the buyback of shares by the company to the tune of Rs. 280 crores with a per share value of Rs. 320 which is much higher than the current market price.

risks_headwinds.claim: The operating environment remained challenging due to geopolitical developments, crude oil price volatility, and fuel procurement cost increases.
risks_headwinds.quote: The operating environment during this quarter remained challenging, particularly due to geopolitical developments, crude oil price volatility and the resulting increase in fuel procurement cost.

risks_headwinds.claim: Fuel cost per litre increased significantly from approximately INR 85 to INR 97.
risks_headwinds.quote: The cost per litre increased significantly from approximately INR 85- INR 97, putting pressure on our operating cost structure.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company is actively managing risks posed by current geopolitical developments and the potential for volatility in fuel rates and other input costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Actively managing risks posed by current geopolitical developments and potential thereof to cause volatility in fuel rates and other input costs

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the company expects volume growth of 9% to 10% in the second half of the year.
management_commitments.quote: This first half, we already did around 9.5% growth in the tonnage. The similar growth we are expecting even in the second half of the year.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that capital expenditure will continue at around INR 250 crores to INR 300 crores every year.
management_commitments.quote: But the capital expenditure will be at least around INR250 crores-INR300 crores every year it will continue, considering our good cash flow.

management_commitments.claim: Management committed to maintaining EBITDA margins in the range of 21% to 22% going forward.
management_commitments.quote: Yes, around 21%-22% is a sustainable EBITDA margin even going forward.

management_commitments.claim: The buy-back process is expected to complete upon settlement of the bids received through the stock exchange mechanism.
management_commitments.quote: The buy-back process is expected to complete upon settlement of the bids received through the stock exchange mechanism.

management_commitments.claim: The consequential reduction in equity share capital and other equity will be recognized in the interim financial results for the quarter and nine-months period ending December 31, 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Accordingly, the consequential reduction in equity share capital and other equity will be recognised in the interim financial results for the quarter and nine-months period ending 31 December 2026.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets full-year capital expenditure to be between Rs. 220 crores and Rs. 240 crores.
management_commitments.quote: And out of this Rs. 500 crores, the CAPEX will be around Rs. 220 crores – Rs. 240 crores, roughly, in a full year basis.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
